facts.text: At 14:00 the dam breaks and Marrow floods. Then it is 08:00 again.
Morning: the gauge reads 8.7 m and rising. Red line is 9.0 m.
After 11:00 the gauge reads 9.4 m. The red line is 9.0 m.
Only the relief valve can save the town. Its key went missing with old Oskar.
The valve is in the Valve Hut by the dam. Only Vera can turn it, and it's a long walk from the Town Hall.
Oskar gave the spare valve key to Tomas the barman, to cover his bar tab.
Tomas is leaving Marrow for good on the 10:20 bus.
The bar's back door doesn't lock once Tomas has gone.
Vera only believes measurements. The gauge climbs after 11:00.
Vera won't take help from anyone rumoured to be a thief.
The Mayor says the dam was inspected last spring and is totally safe.
The Mayor has anyone spreading panic arrested.

questions.text: How do I reach Tomas before he leaves?
Is there another way into the bar?
